free_tier_limits.correction: N/A: there is no free transaction allowance. API-key issuance and integration are free, but processed payments incur a 0.5% service fee without conversion or 1% with autoconversion/fixed-rate features, plus applicable network fees.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits include 7 requests/second for GET /estimate and 3 requests/second for POST /payment.

notes: The API is operational and the core endpoint/authentication description is current. The listed Postman URL has been superseded, endpoint-specific rate limits are officially published, and the status endpoint is documented without an API-key header. NOWPayments provides a free API key and free integration, but not a free processing tier.
